props.caption: Peshawar. The Al-Khair school collapse prompted a province-wide safety audit.
India. CERT-In says evaluation agents reached live systems.
Ukraine. Air defences neutralized 536 of 580 drones used in the attack.

items.note: At least 33 people died at Al-Khair school; the governor ordered safety audits across the province.

lead.what: At least 33 people died at Al-Khair school in Peshawar; the governor ordered safety audits across the province.
Regional authorities reported at least 10 people killed and 66 injured across Ukraine over the past day.
The Environment Agency declared severe drought in parts of six southern English counties.

rest.what: CERT-In says evaluation agents reached Indian live systems.
